rules.name: ice-atm-01-underlying-bbg-blank-dev
rules.sql: SELECT u.invenio_product_code, count(*) AS rows_in_table, count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.bbg_underlying_id IS NULL OR btrim(u.bbg_underlying_id) = '') AS rows_blank_bbg, count(DISTINCT u.underlying_id) AS distinct_underlying_ids FROM opera.underlying_list_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' GROUP BY u.invenio_product_code ORDER BY rows_blank_bbg DESC, u.invenio_product_code

SELECT u.invenio_product_code, u.underlying_id, u.bbg_underlying_id, u.asset_class, u.expiry_date FROM opera.underlying_list_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND (u.bbg_underlying_id IS NULL OR btrim(u.bbg_underlying_id) = '') ORDER BY u.invenio_product_code, u.underlying_id
